erc8004Registration.note: the launch/de-stealth registration; Covenant is now discoverable in ERC-8004 tooling on Base. owner is the relayer EOA (holds no signing authority); the card points at the Solana metaplex identity.

bondReceiptVerifier.note: hardened redeploy: rejects malleable signatures (high-S and v outside {27,28}). replay protection remains the consuming escrow's job. supersedes the first deploy below (unannounced, unconsumed).

supersedes.reason: no malleability guard; never announced or consumed

bondReceiptVerifier.note: same stateless verifier and same canonical attestor as Base — a covenantd-signed bond verifies on 4663 with no chain-local trust root. The Solidity immutable is named USDC but holds USDG (Global Dollar, Paxos, 6-dec). Digests bind chainId 4663, so a Base receipt cannot verify here and vice versa. Proven end-to-end by covenant-attestation/tests/live_rh_bond_verifier.rs: getters pin the canonical attestor + USDG, domainSeparator()/digest() equal the crate for a RobinhoodMainnet receipt (pinned 0x399e5590…67bcfa), the ecrecover precompile recovers the signer, and verify() reverts UntrustedSigner for a non-canonical signer. Replay protection remains the consuming escrow's job.

reputationRegistry.note: chain-agnostic reputation verifier + thin freshest-score store. Unlike the bond verifier, the EIP-712 domain binds a constant salt (keccak256("covenant/reputation/v1")) rather than chainId/verifyingContract, so one canonical-attestor signature verifies here, on Base, and off-chain — a reputation score is a Solana-canonical fact true on every chain at once. Same canonical attestor as the bond verifiers (no chain-local trust root). Fields align with covenantMainnet.reputationSchema (score/scoreDecimals/validUntil/sourceChain/solanaAttestation) plus a bytes32 subject binding the agent's Solana identity. Proven by covenant-attestation/tests/live_rh_reputation_registry.rs: TRUSTED_ATTESTOR() pins the canonical attestor, domainSeparator()/digest() equal the crate (pinned 0xa1810486…562fb / 0xe9a0fe2c…dcccef5), the ecrecover precompile recovers the signer, verify() reverts UntrustedSigner for a non-canonical live signer and Expired for a past-dated score. postReputation keeps only the freshest score per subject by validUntil.

usdgSettlement.note: Generic (non-escrow) x402 USDG settlement proven live on 4663. The covenant-x402 EvmSigner signs an EIP-3009 exact-scheme authorization (domain "Global Dollar" v1, separator pinned 0x7a3d7400…62036) and EvmRpc broadcasts transferWithAuthorization to the USDG token — no SpendGrantEscrow, spend grant, or provider allowlist on the path, so any USDG-priced x402 resource is payable on 4663 with the same signer covenant-x402 uses for USDC on Base. Proof tx moved 0.01 USDG payer→payee and emitted AuthorizationUsed + Transfer with status 1. Proven by covenant-x402/tests/live_rh_usdg_settlement.rs: signs via EvmSigner, preflights the call (a tampered signature reverts — the settle enforces the covenant-x402 authorization signature, not a bare transfer), submits via EvmRpc, and asserts payer/payee USDG balances move by exactly the settled value.

rwaTradeGuard.note: on-chain half of covenant-rwa-firewall: checkTrade bounds a tokenized-equity trade by the asset's Chainlink price, its age, the ERC-8056 uiMultiplier, the token's oraclePaused flag, and a per-asset notional cap, so a trade that breaks a bound reverts before it reaches the venue. Assets are owner-registered against an 8-decimal feed, which is what keeps a look-alike token with the right ticker untradeable. No Chainlink L2 sequencer uptime feed is published on 4663, so that check is left unset; it enables the moment one exists. Parity with the Rust policy is proven on live data by covenant-rwa-firewall/tests/live_rh_rwa_guard.rs.

guardedTradeExecutor.note: the executing half: buy() runs the guard on the intended size and quoted price before any USDG is pulled, routes the swap through an owner-allowlisted venue, enforces the minimum out on its own balance delta, refunds unspent USDG, and delivers the token to the caller. Holds no funds between trades. This chain's UniversalRouter pulls the payer through Permit2, so an allowlisted venue is primed once via primeRouter; its ExactInputSingleParams also carries an extra minHopPriceX36 before hookData, which a caller building swap calldata has to encode.

identityProjection.note: The canonical ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry (deterministic 0x8004A169…a432, live on Base 8453) is NOT deployed on 4663: the vanity address holds only a bare OpenZeppelin UUPS+Ownable shell (MinimalUUPSMainnet — 8 fns: initialize/owner/upgradeToAndCall/proxiableUUID/getVersion/transfer|renounceOwnership/UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION), never upgraded to registry logic, so register(string) reverts 0x. Its owner (0x5472…2603) is a third party, not the Covenant deployer, so we cannot upgrade the proxy. Covenant identity is Solana-canonical; the Base ERC-8004 entry (agentId 58403) is a discoverability projection into existing ERC-8004 indexers, of which none run on 4663. Self-deploying a registry nobody indexes would be receipts-theater, so 4663 identity projection is deferred until the ecosystem upgrades the canonical proxy. First-class 4663 trust is carried by the settlement/bond/reputation primitives above, not by an EVM identity root.
